zh.description: 声明的能力，如 `stream`、`tools`、`json_schema`、`vision`（可输入图片）、`tts`（语音合成）、`asr`（语音识别）。

tags.description: Display tags. Omitted if not set.

meter.description: What is metered: `input`, `input_cache_read`, `input_cache_write`, `output`, `output_reasoning`, `request`, `image` (generated images), `input_char` (speech-synthesis input characters) or `audio_second` (transcribed audio duration).

ChatCompletionRequest.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion request. Only the fields below are read or rewritten by the gateway; all other fields (e.g. `temperature`, `top_p`, `stop`) are passed through to the upstream unchanged.

max_completion_tokens.description: Alternative to `max_tokens`; the smaller of the two is used for pre-authorization.

zh.description: `max_tokens` 的替代字段；预扣时取两者中较小值。

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens. The pre-authorized amount is based on min(`max_tokens`, `max_completion_tokens`, model max output, 8192).

zh.description: 最大输出 token 数。预扣金额按 min(`max_tokens`、`max_completion_tokens`、模型最大输出、8192) 计算。

messages.description: Conversation messages, passed through unchanged. Their text size counts toward the input-token estimate used for pre-authorization; each image counts as a fixed 1,500 tokens.

content.description: Message content: a string or an array of content parts, e.g. `{"type": "text", "text": "..."}` and `{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "https://... or data:image/png;base64,..."}}` (images need a model with the `vision` capability).

zh.description: 消息内容：字符串或内容分段数组，如 `{"type": "text", "text": "..."}` 与 `{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "https://... 或 data:image/png;base64,..."}}`（图片需要具备 `vision` 能力的模型）。
一条对话消息（原样透传）。
对话消息，原样透传；文本大小计入预扣时的输入 token 估算，每张图片按固定 1,500 token 估算。

model.description: Model ID, e.g. `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash` (see `GET /v1/models`). Rewritten to the channel's upstream model name before forwarding.

zh.description: 模型 ID，如 `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`（见 `GET /v1/models`）。转发前会被改写为渠道的上游模型名。

type.description: If `json_schema` or `json_object`, only channels with the `json_schema` capability are used.

zh.description: 为 `json_schema` 或 `json_object` 时只路由到具备 `json_schema` 能力的渠道。

stream.description: If `true`, the response is a `text/event-stream` of `chat.completion.chunk` events. The model's channel must support streaming.

zh.description: 为 `true` 时以 `text/event-stream` 返回 `chat.completion.chunk` 事件流；渠道需支持流式。

include_usage.description: Set to `true` to receive the final usage-only chunk (empty `choices`). The gateway always requests usage from the upstream for billing, but only forwards this chunk if you set this yourself.

zh.description: 设为 `true` 才会收到最后那个只含 usage 的 chunk（`choices` 为空）。网关为计费总会向上游索取 usage，但只有你自己设置了此项才转发该 chunk。

tools.description: Tool definitions (passed through). If non-empty, only channels with the `tools` capability are used.

zh.description: 工具定义（原样透传）。非空时只路由到具备 `tools` 能力的渠道。
OpenAI 兼容的对话补全请求。网关只读取或改写下列字段；其余字段（如 `temperature`、`top_p`、`stop`）原样透传给上游。

ChatCompletionResponse.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion. The upstream response is passed through; only `id` (set to the request ID) and `model` (set to the requested model ID) are rewritten.

zh.description: 上游返回的 Unix 时间戳（秒）。

id.description: The request ID (same as the `X-Request-Id` response header).

zh.description: 请求 ID（与响应头 `X-Request-Id` 相同）。

usage.description: Token usage reported by the upstream; billing is based on it.

zh.description: 上游报告的 token 用量，计费以此为准。
OpenAI 兼容的对话补全结果。上游响应原样透传，只改写 `id`（改为请求 ID）和 `model`（改为所请求的模型 ID）。

EmbeddingRequest.description: OpenAI-compatible embeddings request. Only `model` is read and rewritten by the gateway; all other fields (e.g. `encoding_format`, `dimensions`) are passed through to the upstream unchanged.

input.description: Text or array of texts to embed (passed through).

zh.description: 要向量化的文本或文本数组（原样透传）。

model.description: ID of an `embedding`-type model; other model types return `404 model_not_found`.

zh.description: `embedding` 类型的模型 ID；其他类型的模型返回 `404 model_not_found`。

EmbeddingResponse.description: OpenAI-compatible embeddings result. The upstream response is passed through; only `id` (set to the request ID) and `model` are rewritten.

zh.description: 向量列表，每个输入一条。

id.description: The request ID (added by the gateway).

usage.description: Token usage; only input tokens are billed.

zh.description: token 用量；只按输入 token 计费。
OpenAI 兼容的向量嵌入结果。上游响应原样透传，只改写 `id`（改为请求 ID）和 `model`。

Error.description: Error response (OpenAI-compatible). Branch on `error.code`, not on `message`.

zh.description: 稳定的机器可读错误码，见 `x-error-codes`。
给人看的英文说明，可能变化。

request_id.description: Request ID, same as the `X-Request-Id` response header.

zh.description: 请求 ID，与响应头 `X-Request-Id` 相同。

type.description: Error category derived from the HTTP status: `invalid_request_error` (400/404), `authentication_error` (401), `insufficient_quota` (402), `permission_error` (403), `rate_limit_error` (429), `api_error` (5xx).

zh.description: 由 HTTP 状态决定的错误类别：`invalid_request_error`（400/404）、`authentication_error`（401）、`insufficient_quota`（402）、`permission_error`（403）、`rate_limit_error`（429）、`api_error`（5xx）。
错误响应（OpenAI 兼容）。程序应按 `error.code` 判断，不要依赖 `message`。

ImageGenerationRequest.description: Image generation request. Only `model` is rewritten; all other fields are passed through, so both the OpenAI fields (`n`, `size`) and upstream-native fields (e.g. SiliconFlow's `image_size`, `batch_size`, `num_inference_steps`, `negative_prompt`, `seed`) can be used.

n.description: Number of images, 1-4 (default 1). `batch_size` is accepted as an alias.

size.description: Image size such as `1024x1024`; supported values depend on the model.

zh.description: 图片尺寸，如 `1024x1024`；可选值取决于模型。
图像生成请求。只改写 `model`，其余字段原样透传，因此 OpenAI 字段（`n`、`size`）和上游原生字段（如 SiliconFlow 的 `image_size`、`batch_size`、`num_inference_steps`、`negative_prompt`、`seed`）都可以使用。

ImageGenerationResponse.description: Generated images (OpenAI shape). Image URLs are temporary — download them promptly (SiliconFlow URLs expire after 1 hour).

b64_json.description: Base64 image, when the model returns it instead of a URL.

zh.description: 模型返回 base64 而非链接时的图片数据。
生成的图片；按条数计费。
生成的图片（OpenAI 形状）。图片 URL 是临时链接，请及时下载（SiliconFlow 的链接 1 小时后失效）。

audio_formats.description: Audio formats speech synthesis actually returns, regardless of `response_format`.

zh.description: 语音合成实际返回的音频格式（与 `response_format` 无关）。

max_file_bytes.description: Maximum size of an uploaded file (speech recognition), in bytes.

zh.description: 上传文件（语音识别）的大小上限，字节。

zh.description: 最大输出 token 数。网关不强制（与 Anthropic 官方不同），但建议填写：可降低预扣金额。
固定为 `text`；非文本块会被忽略。
base64 图片数据（不带 `data:` 前缀）。

zh.description: 字符串，或 `text` 与 `image` 块组成的数组（图片需要具备 `vision` 能力的模型）；其他类型的块会被忽略。

model.description: Model ID, e.g. `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`. Any chat model works, not only Claude models.

zh.description: 模型 ID，如 `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`。任何对话模型都可以，不限于 Claude。
固定为 `text`；非文本块会被忽略。

system.description: System prompt: a string or an array of `text` blocks.

MessageResponse.description: Anthropic Messages API response with a single text block.

content.description: Exactly one `text` block with the generated text.

zh.description: 固定为 `text`；非文本块会被忽略。
恰好一个 `text` 块，内容为生成的文本。

id.description: The request ID (same as the `X-Request-Id` response header).

zh.description: 请求 ID（与响应头 `X-Request-Id` 相同）。
Anthropic Messages API 响应，只含一个文本块。

post.description:
Converts text to speech and returns the audio file. `model` must be an `audio` model with the `tts` capability. The body is passed through (only `model` is rewritten; short `voice` names are prefixed with the upstream model name where the upstream requires it).

**Response.** Binary audio with the upstream's `Content-Type` (e.g. `audio/mpeg`). With `stream: true` the audio is sent in chunks as it is generated — plain chunked binary, not SSE.

**Billing.** Per input character (`input_char` meter, counted as Unicode characters of `input`). The amount is known up front, so it is also charged in full if you disconnect mid-stream.

example.input: 今天天气很好，我们一起去公园散步吧。

zh.description:
把文本合成为语音并返回音频文件。`model` 必须是具备 `tts` 能力的 `audio` 模型。请求体原样透传（只改写 `model`；上游要求时，短音色名会自动补上上游模型前缀）。

**响应。** 二进制音频，`Content-Type` 与上游一致（如 `audio/mpeg`）。`stream: true` 时边生成边分块返回——是普通的分块二进制，不是 SSE。

**计费。** 按输入字符数计费（`input_char` 计量项，按 `input` 的 Unicode 字符计）。费用在请求时就确定，流式中途断开也按全额计费。

post.description:
Transcribes an uploaded audio file to text. Send `multipart/form-data` with `file` and `model` (an `audio` model with the `asr` capability); other form fields are passed through. The whole request must stay under 20 MB. The upstream response is returned unchanged (`text/plain` for `response_format` `text`/`srt`/`vtt`).

**Billing.** By audio duration (`audio_second` meter), taken from the upstream's `usage.seconds` or `duration`; if the upstream reports none, WAV files are measured from the header and other formats are estimated from the file size. Models may also charge a per-request fee (`request` meter).

**计费。** 按音频时长计费（`audio_second` 计量项），取上游返回的 `usage.seconds` 或 `duration`；上游没有返回时，WAV 文件按文件头计算，其他格式按文件大小估算。模型也可能按次收取费用（`request` 计量项）。

post.description:
OpenAI-compatible chat completion. The gateway checks `model`, the key's model allow-list, rate limits and balance, then forwards the body to an upstream channel. Only `model` is rewritten (to the channel's upstream model name); all other fields are passed through. In the response, `model` is the model ID you requested and `id` is the request ID (same as `X-Request-Id`).

**Billing.** Before forwarding, an estimated cost is frozen in your wallet: input tokens are estimated from the text size of the body (about 4 bytes per token; each image counts as a fixed 1,500 tokens), output tokens = min(`max_tokens`/`max_completion_tokens`, model max output, 8192). After the call the real cost is settled from the upstream `usage` and the rest is released. If the upstream returns no usage, a non-streaming call is billed at the estimate. Failed calls are not charged.

**Failover.** If an upstream call fails before anything is sent to you, the gateway retries on another key or channel (up to 3 attempts within 90 s). Once a stream has started there is no retry.

**Streaming.** With `stream: true` the response is `text/event-stream` carrying `chat.completion.chunk` events (`data: {...}`). The gateway always asks the upstream for usage (for billing), but forwards the usage-only chunk (empty `choices`) only if you set `stream_options.include_usage: true` yourself. The upstream `data: [DONE]` line is not forwarded: the stream ends when the connection closes. If you disconnect mid-stream before usage arrives, output is billed by estimating tokens from the bytes already forwarded to you (never more than the frozen estimate).

**Images.** Put `image_url` parts (an `https://` URL or a `data:image/...;base64,` URL) in `messages[].content` and use a model whose `capabilities` include `vision`. The whole body must stay under 20 MB (`413 request_too_large`).

**Routing.** Requests with `stream: true`, non-empty `tools`, or `response_format.type` of `json_schema`/`json_object` only go to channels with that capability, and the estimated input plus reserved output must fit the channel's context window; otherwise `503 no_available_channel`. The model must be a `chat` model (`404 model_not_found` otherwise).

**计费。** 转发前先在钱包里冻结一笔预估费用：输入 token 按请求体中文本的大小估算（约 4 字节 1 个 token，每张图片按固定 1,500 token 计），输出 token = min(`max_tokens`/`max_completion_tokens`、模型最大输出、8192)。调用结束后按上游返回的 `usage` 结算实际费用并释放剩余冻结。上游没有返回 usage 时，非流式请求按预估值计费。失败的请求不计费。

**故障转移。** 在向你写出任何内容之前上游失败时，网关会换 Key 或换渠道重试（90 秒内最多 3 次）。流式输出一旦开始就不再重试。

**图片。** 在 `messages[].content` 中放入 `image_url` 分段（`https://` 链接或 `data:image/...;base64,` 数据），并使用 `capabilities` 含 `vision` 的模型。整个请求体不能超过 20 MB（否则 `413 request_too_large`）。

**路由。** `stream: true`、非空 `tools`、或 `response_format.type` 为 `json_schema`/`json_object` 的请求只会路由到具备相应能力的渠道，且预估输入加预留输出不能超过渠道的上下文窗口；否则返回 `503 no_available_channel`。模型必须是 `chat` 类型（否则 `404 model_not_found`）。
